questions.prompt: You docker rm a container. What happens to the image it was created from?
choices: The image is deleted too
The image stays; docker rm removes the instance, not the snapshot
The image is untagged but the layers remain only if you used --rm
Docker asks you to docker rmi first
questions.why: An image is the immutable snapshot. A container is an instance. docker ps lists containers; docker images lists images.

choices: The running app
Instructions that docker build uses to produce an image; docker run starts a container from that image
A Compose file with one service
A Kubernetes Pod template
questions.why: The Dockerfile does not run your app. docker build produces an image; docker run starts a container from it.

choices: Host port 80 to container port 8080
Host port 8080 to container port 80
Both ports to 0.0.0.0:80
The container’s localhost to your laptop’s 8080 without publishing
questions.why: -p HOST:CONTAINER. curl http://127.0.0.1:8080 hits the host port. Inside the container the process still sees :80. localhost inside the container is the container.

questions.prompt: COPY . . near the top of a Dockerfile is usually a bad idea because:
choices: COPY cannot copy directories
Any file change, including a README typo, invalidates every later layer
The image will not have a CMD
Docker ignores COPY on Alpine
questions.why: Put lines that change least first. COPY . . early busts the cache on every edit. That is what .dockerignore is for.

questions.prompt: A bind mount versus a named volume:
choices: They are the same; Docker picks one at random
A bind mount is a host path; a named volume is Docker-managed storage
Named volumes are only for Kubernetes
Bind mounts persist after docker rm; named volumes never do
questions.why: Container filesystems are thrown away. Bind mounts are a host path (good while you edit). Named volumes are better for database data.

questions.prompt: Why does this guide pin tags like nginx:1.27-alpine instead of latest?
choices: latest is slower to pull
latest moves; a rebuild next month can be a different image than the one you tested
Alpine images cannot use latest
Pinned tags skip the registry
questions.why: latest is a moving pointer. Production images pin a version so you can explain what is running.

questions.prompt: When should you not reach for Docker?
choices: When you need the same filesystem on a laptop and in CI
A one-off debug on the host (journalctl, ss, a local binary)
When you will run the same app on kind later
When Compose would replace a long docker run
questions.why: A one-off debug on the host does not need Docker. Do not wrap a single curl in an image to look official.
